entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: A wise sphinx and the Hegemon of all of Esper.

entities.name: Xorin
entities.description: A human archmage of the Architects of Will who advises Sharuum.

entities.name: Travius
entities.description: A blue-skinned vedalken mage of Magister rank and a Seeker of Carmot who divines with an armillary sphere.

entities.name: Callio
entities.description: An officer of the Ethersworn and secretly a Seeker of Carmot, sister of Agatha; killed by her.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: A prosaic soldier of Esper, sister of Callio, stranded in Harborgate off Bant.

entities.name: Jaria
entities.description: Callio's daughter, whose death Callio blames on herself.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: A brilliant sphinx whose gift of etherium gave rise to monstrosities like aether-liches.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker who co-opted the Seekers' mission for his own purposes.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A character whose father scavenged etherium in Esper's cesspool quarters.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: A sect of Esper mages seeking the red stone needed to create new etherium, unknowingly driven by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: Esper order devoted to the Noble Work of perfecting life with etherium.

entities.name: Architects of Will
entities.description: A wizard sect of Esper to which Xorin belongs.

entities.name: Harborgate
entities.description: An Esper spire lost to an incursion zone and now off the coast of Jhess in Bant.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara reliant on etherium, under pressure from Bant and Grixis.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose creatures and magics bewilder Esperites.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara that looks like a hell to Esperites.

entities.name: Jhess
entities.description: A nation of Bant off whose coast Harborgate emerged.

entities.name: Inkwell Sea
entities.description: A sea of Esper, fifteen grid-squares of which were subsumed.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: The collision of Alara's shards that threatens Esper's land and etherium.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: The aether-infused metal vital to Esper's life.

events.summary: Xorin and Sharuum learn from a scout that the spire Harborgate is lost, with twenty-seven missing and much etherium gone.
Sharuum refuses Xorin's call for an invasion and orders the armillaries consulted.
events.quote: Incorrect. First we consult the armillaries.

events.summary: Agatha and Callio, stranded on Harborgate, try to snare floating dead bodies to salvage etherium.
events.quote: I need them for their etherium.

events.summary: Travius, a Seeker, divines the location of Harborgate with an armillary sphere.
events.quote: Harborgate. It's there, past the Inkwell, past Esper's frontier.

events.summary: Callio kills a Bant aven scout with the crossbow and Agatha realizes her sister is a Seeker.
events.quote: CALLIO fires at the aven scout, piercing it in the heart.

events.summary: Callio reveals her daughter Jaria was lost and that the Seekers need etherium.
events.quote: My daughter was just one of the mistakes

events.summary: Travius reveals each outlying tower is seeded with a Seeker, so the loss of Harborgate may serve the mission.
events.quote: Someone to ensure that disaster can be turned into opportunity.

events.summary: Callio integrates etherium into the dead aven and Agatha refuses to help.
events.quote: I'm not helping you do anything.

events.summary: Agatha shoots and kills Callio, then swims to the shore of Jhess.
events.quote: The bolt slams into CALLIO's chest.

events.summary: Four days later Travius reports no word from Harborgate and Sharuum accepts the Seekers' way.

relations.quote: wise sphinx and the Hegemon of all of Esper
This world has already sunk its claws into you, sister.
The bolt slams into CALLIO's chest.

relations.note: Bolas motivated and co-opted their quest.
relations.quote: their quest has been motivated by the dragon planeswalker Nicol Bolas
